pages.description: Lily Lovebraids from Poppy Playtime spreads her hands in this printable coloring page, with three long braids framing her smiling face and star pinafore. Her doll joints, curled forelock, diamond skirt border, and star-covered socks add small shapes throughout the otherwise uncluttered character portrait.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Wearing Her Princess Dress and Crown Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Poppy Playtime's Lily Lovebraids wearing her princess dress and crown, holding out the sides of her wide, layered skirt. Stars decorate the crown, bodice, gathered overskirt, and socks, while her long braids curve down beside the puffed sleeves.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids in Her Circus Clown Dress Coloring Page
pages.description: Lily Lovebraids wears her circus clown dress in this printable coloring page, smiling beneath a pointed party hat as her braids swing around her shoulders. A ruffled collar, two large pom-pom buttons, and a skirt edged with round ornaments define the Poppy Playtime doll's playful costume.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids in Her Starry Night Dress Coloring Page
pages.description: A starry night dress surrounds Lily Lovebraids with moons and stars in this printable coloring page, showing the Poppy Playtime doll seated beside a tea table. She holds a decorated cup near a matching teapot and tiered cakes, with a curtained night window and star-patterned rug completing the room.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids in Her Pool Party Outfit Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Lily Lovebraids in her pool party outfit, lifting her star-shaped sunglasses while a star-patterned swim ring rests around her waist. The Poppy Playtime doll stands beside a swimming pool, with a beach ball, ladder, lounge chair, and umbrella arranged behind and around her.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Brushing Her Hair at a Dressing Table Coloring Page
pages.description: Lily Lovebraids brushes her long hair at a dressing table in this printable coloring page, smiling beside an oval mirror with a star on top. A comb, spare brush, and heart-topped container sit on the vanity, while her thick braids fall around the stool and diamond-trimmed skirt.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Braiding Her Hair in Front of a Mirror Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page captures Lily Lovebraids braiding her hair in front of a mirror, with her hands and smiling reflection visible beside the long braid. The Poppy Playtime doll sits on a round stool at a simple vanity, wearing her star pinafore, patterned skirt, and strapped shoes.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Choosing a Dress From Her Dollhouse Wardrobe Coloring Page
pages.description: Lily Lovebraids chooses a dress from her dollhouse wardrobe in this printable coloring page, lifting a hanger beside the open doors of a heart-decorated cabinet. The dress has puffed sleeves, a waist bow, and a scalloped hem, with another outfit hanging behind the smiling Poppy Playtime doll.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Having a Sleepover with Her Toy Friends Coloring Page
pages.description: A sleepover brings Lily Lovebraids and her toy friends together in this printable coloring page, with the Poppy Playtime doll seated among pillows and cushions. A button-eyed doll, a toy wearing a nightcap, and a small spider-like companion gather beside a folded blanket decorated with stars.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Beside Her Framed Portrait in the Dollhouse Attic Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places Lily Lovebraids beside her framed portrait in the dollhouse attic, pointing toward the smiling likeness hanging on the paneled wall. Sloping roof beams and wooden floorboards surround the Poppy Playtime doll, while flower ornaments accent the portrait's curved frame.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Holding Candy Cat as a Puppet Coloring Page
pages.description: Lily Lovebraids holds Candy Cat as a puppet in this printable coloring page, smiling above the large cat face positioned in front of her skirt. Pointed ears, round cheeks, a tiny nose, and an open mouth give the puppet its expression, with a toy box and ball nearby.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Holding Glowby and Baby Long Legs with Candy Cat Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Lily Lovebraids holding Glowby and Baby Long Legs with Candy Cat, gathering the three Poppy Playtime toys on her lap. Her long braids surround the group, with Glowby's star-shaped outline, Baby Long Legs' thin limbs, and Candy Cat's striped forehead providing distinct details.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Talking with Giblet Coloring Page
pages.description: Lily Lovebraids talks with Giblet in this printable coloring page, leaning toward the smaller Poppy Playtime character with both hands open in a friendly gesture. Giblet has tall patched ears, an eye patch, a flower-shaped eye, and a cane, with a flower panel and overhead pipe behind them.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Hiding Behind a Tree on Halloween Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Lily Lovebraids hiding behind a tree on Halloween, peeking around the trunk with a broad grin and her long braids visible. A carved jack-o'-lantern rests at the roots, while fallen leaves, bare branches, a fence, and a large moon establish the autumn setting.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Peeking Out Among Christmas Decorations Coloring Page
pages.description: Lily Lovebraids peeks out among Christmas decorations in this printable coloring page, leaning around a tree topped with a large star and draped in bead garlands. Snowflake and star baubles hang between bows, and a ribbon-wrapped present sits beneath the branches beside the smiling Poppy Playtime doll.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Outside Her Giant Dollhouse Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Lily Lovebraids outside her giant dollhouse, standing with her hands on her hips along a path of rounded stepping stones. The house has a heart above its entrance, arched windows with flower boxes, a scalloped roof, and matching heart-topped fence posts.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Walking Along Sweet Street Beneath Hanging Clouds Coloring Page
pages.description: Lily Lovebraids walks along Sweet Street beneath hanging clouds in this printable coloring page, taking a long step past a building topped with oversized wrapped candy. Her three braids fan outward above a curving path, with round fence posts, bushes, and an awning surrounding the Poppy Playtime scene.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Riding the Sweet Street Playground Slide Coloring Page
pages.description: A playground slide carries Lily Lovebraids through Sweet Street in this printable coloring page, with the smiling Poppy Playtime doll seated between the raised side rails. Her shoes point down the chute, while long braids, star-patterned socks, candy-shaped decorations, and a frosted-looking building fill the surrounding scene.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Sitting on a Sweet Street Playground Swing Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Lily Lovebraids sitting on a Sweet Street playground swing, gripping both ropes as her braids spread out behind her head. The wooden seat hangs above stepping stones and grass, with flowered bushes, a picket fence, and candy-styled buildings behind the Poppy Playtime doll.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Standing Beside the Sweet Street Ice Cream Truck Coloring Page
pages.description: Lily Lovebraids stands beside the Sweet Street ice cream truck in this printable coloring page, extending one hand toward its open serving window and striped awning. A giant ice cream cone tops the vehicle, while stacked cones, scoops in tubs, scalloped trim, and dripping decorations add smaller shapes.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Greeting the Grabpack Player at Sweet Street's Final Gate Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Lily Lovebraids greeting the Grabpack player at Sweet Street's final gate, reaching out one hand toward the visitor facing her. Stars top the gateposts and decorate its panels, while the player's backpack, coiled hoses, and mechanical gloves provide details opposite Lily's flowing braids.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Wrapping Her Braids Around the Grabpack Player Coloring Page
pages.description: Lily Lovebraids wraps her braids around the Grabpack player in this printable coloring page, smiling beside the figure with both mechanical hands raised in surprise. Thick woven strands loop across the player's torso, contrasting with the visor, backpack tubing, knee patches, and heavy boots in the Poppy Playtime scene.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Discovering Poppy Beneath a Broken Vent Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Lily Lovebraids discovering Poppy beneath a broken vent, reaching toward the seated doll amid pieces of debris scattered across the floor. The damaged grille hangs from a cracked ceiling opening, while Poppy's curled pigtails, hair bows, and ruffled dress stand out below it.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Opening the Dollhouse Dining Room Door Coloring Page
pages.description: Lily Lovebraids opens the dollhouse dining room door in this printable coloring page, holding the knob while welcoming a visitor with her other hand extended. Beyond the doorway, heart-backed chairs surround a table set with cups and flowers, with dishes displayed in a cabinet beside the curtained window.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Receiving a Plate of Crumpets From the Player Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Lily Lovebraids receiving a plate of crumpets from the player, with their hands meeting around the tray in a kitchen doorway. Three round crumpets fill the plate, while cabinets, a stool, a window, and a heart-decorated flower mug appear behind the smiling doll.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Hosting a Tea Party with Dusky, Baby, and Dolly Grub Coloring Page
pages.description: Lily Lovebraids hosts a tea party with Dusky, Baby, and Dolly Grub in this printable coloring page, standing behind the round table with a teapot. Her guests hold patterned cups around the diamond-trimmed tablecloth, bringing button eyes, curled hair, and a dangling nightcap into the Poppy Playtime gathering.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Changing the Dining Room Music Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Lily Lovebraids changing the dining room music, turning a crank on a round music box decorated with stars beside her. A tea service and flower vase sit on the larger table behind her, with a curtained window, dining chairs, and circular rug completing the room.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Setting Teacups Around the Tea Table Coloring Page
pages.description: Lily Lovebraids sets teacups around the tea table in this printable coloring page, lowering a cup and saucer beside two more cups and a teapot. Her long braids frame the star on her pinafore, while the simple chair, draped tablecloth, and curved pedestal legs leave the tea setting clearly outlined.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Pouring Tea for Candy Cat Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Lily Lovebraids pouring tea for Candy Cat, tilting a star-decorated teapot over the matching cup on a small round table. Candy Cat smiles from a cushioned chair beside her, with pointed ears, whiskers, and an open mouth above the tabletop and oval rug.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Carrying a Teapot with One Braid Coloring Page
pages.description: Lily Lovebraids carries a teapot with one braid in this printable coloring page, curling the thick strand around its handle while keeping her hands near her waist. A cup and saucer wait on the nearby table beside a plate of dotted treats, and the other long braids arch outward.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Baking Crumpets in the Dollhouse Kitchen Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Lily Lovebraids baking crumpets in the dollhouse kitchen, holding a tray of three round crumpets beside the open oven door. Quilted oven mitts cover her hands, and heart-decorated cabinets, a kettle, cooking utensils, and a curtained sink window surround the Poppy Playtime doll.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Leading the Grabpack Player Into the Kitchen Coloring Page
pages.description: Lily Lovebraids leads the Grabpack player into the kitchen in this printable coloring page, pointing toward an open recipe book as the visitor enters behind her. A mixing bowl, rolling pin, and utensil holder line the counter, while the player's large visor, hoses, and raised gloves fill the doorway.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Tidying the Kitchen Counter Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Lily Lovebraids tidying the kitchen counter, wiping its surface with a cloth while holding a mug in her other hand. A closed cookbook rests beside her, with a hanging pan and oven mitt, sink taps, arched window, and potted plant arranged in the background.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Reading Her Recipe Book Coloring Page
pages.description: Lily Lovebraids reads her recipe book in this printable coloring page, seated at a kitchen table with the illustrated pages spread open between her hands. A cup and crumpets appear in the book, echoing the teapot beside her, while jars, hanging utensils, and a flowerpot decorate the room.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Writing in Her Journal Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page captures Lily Lovebraids writing in her journal, sitting at a desk with a pencil poised over an open book decorated with hearts. A lamp, pencil cup, and stacked books stand beside her, with a curtained window, star picture, and flower-shaped bed cushion behind the stool.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Covering a Broken Nursery Window with a Poster Coloring Page
pages.description: Lily Lovebraids covers a broken nursery window with a poster in this printable coloring page, pressing a picture of herself across the damaged glass panel. Tape holds the poster near the top, while a remaining crack, bow-tied curtain, teddy bear, and flower-decorated toy chest add details around her.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Closing Her Heart-shaped Locket Bed Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Lily Lovebraids closing her heart-shaped locket bed, with both hands resting along the raised lid above its pillow and blanket. Small hearts and curved garlands decorate the bed's outer rim, while a flower vase and curtained window sit behind the smiling Poppy Playtime doll.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Guarding the Basement Cell with a Braid Around Its Lock Coloring Page
pages.description: Lily Lovebraids guards the basement cell with a braid around its lock in this printable coloring page, standing beside the barred door with a broad grin. The woven strand loops around a large heart-shaped padlock, with riveted crossbars, stone walls, and floor tiles reinforcing the enclosed Poppy Playtime setting.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Confronting Poppy and Kissy Missy in the Basement Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Lily Lovebraids confronting Poppy and Kissy Missy in the basement, pointing toward the two characters standing behind tall cell bars. Poppy grips the bars below Kissy Missy's toothy grin, while a hanging lamp, exposed pipe, and block walls frame the Poppy Playtime scene.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Searching for the Player Outside Her Bedroom Coloring Page
pages.description: Lily Lovebraids searches for the player outside her bedroom in this printable coloring page, peeking past an open door while carrying a large cat-faced toy. Her long braids hang beside a glass-fronted wardrobe, and the paneled door, round knob, striped floorboards, and runner rug define the narrow interior.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Explaining Her Red Light, Green Light Game Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Lily Lovebraids explaining her Red Light, Green Light game, raising an open palm while her long braids curve across the floor. The star on her pinafore and diamond skirt border stand out against the dollhouse room's simple arched window, doorway, and paneled walls.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Blocking the Player's Path with Braids During the Blacklight Game Coloring Page
pages.description: Lily Lovebraids blocks the player's path with her braids during the Blacklight game in this printable coloring page, stretching a thick strand across a dollhouse hallway. The player's mechanical gloves fill the foreground, one holding a star-shaped device, with framed wall panels and a door behind Lily.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Catching the Player Poppy and Kissy Missy in the Attic Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Lily Lovebraids catching the player, Poppy, and Kissy Missy in the attic, spreading her arms beneath the wooden roof beams. The Grabpack player faces her with raised gloves, while Poppy and Kissy Missy stand nearby among stacked crates, a chest, and a small window.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Seated Beside Poppy and Kissy Missy at the Tea Party Coloring Page
pages.description: Lily Lovebraids sits beside Poppy and Kissy Missy at a tea party in this printable coloring page, with all three holding cups around the decorated table. Hearts and bows repeat across the cups, teapot, cookies, chairs, and scalloped tablecloth, while a small flower vase rests near Kissy Missy.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Welcoming the Prototype to Her Tea Party Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Lily Lovebraids welcoming the Prototype to her tea party, extending one hand toward an enormous mechanical hand entering through the doorway. A heart-decorated teapot and cups, a plate of round treats, flower vase, and matching chairs wait on and around the small table.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Watching Kissy Missy Confront the Prototype Coloring Page
pages.description: Lily Lovebraids watches Kissy Missy confront the Prototype in this printable coloring page, holding a cat-faced toy beside the table set for their tea party. Kissy Missy raises a hand toward the giant mechanical fingers emerging from a damaged doorway, with exposed cables and rubble surrounding the opening.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Chasing the Player Through a Dollhouse Hallway Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page captures Lily Lovebraids chasing the player through a dollhouse hallway, reaching forward as the Grabpack-wearing figure runs toward the front of the scene. Her braids fly outward above the paneled walls, and the long floorboards emphasize the corridor stretching behind the two running characters.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Following the Player Onto the Dollhouse Roof Coloring Page
pages.description: Lily Lovebraids follows the player onto the dollhouse roof in this printable coloring page, stepping along the tiled ridge beneath cloud decorations suspended on cables. The player's bulky backpack and coiled hoses face the viewer, while a brick chimney, overlapping roof tiles, and Lily's trailing braids outline the rooftop scene.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Balancing on a Hanging Cloud Platform Above Sweet Street Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Lily Lovebraids balancing on a hanging cloud platform above Sweet Street, holding her arms outward between the platform's two suspension ropes. Candy-styled rooftops, a clock-fronted building, a giant lollipop, trees, and streetlamps appear far below the Poppy Playtime doll's star-patterned socks and strapped shoes.

pages.title: Poppy Playtime Lily Lovebraids Alone in the Lullaby Room Coloring Page
pages.description: Lily Lovebraids sits alone in the Lullaby Room in this printable coloring page, resting both hands neatly on her lap beneath her smiling doll face. A wall speaker hangs above star and cloud decorations, with a closed door, small play structure, and circular rug surrounding the simple wooden chair.
